# Official upgrade v0.2.13

- Target: `v0.2.13`.

- Official tag and commit: `v0.2.13` / `3040209f205472038c1ba745a1bedd2edd9053b1`.
- Previous Vendor baseline: `vendor-0.2.9` / `4c00df2e0183e2c70b7fa8ba45914205e36aad0c`.
- Upgrade branch: `upgrade/v0.2.13`.
- Upgrade mode: common history confirmed; official `v0.2.13` was merged with `git merge --no-ff`.
- Official increment: 310 files, `+14905/-915`; 81 files overlapped existing Custom changes and were reviewed.

## Custom changes

- Preserved Custom payment channels, inventory reservations, OAuth flow, currency and amount validation, affiliate behavior, and model access control.
- Integrated official recharge bonus tiers, `bonus_amount`, TypeSafe, GPT-6.1 compatibility, Claude reset credits, X Search, and WebSocket Composite routing.
- Resolved duplicate generated/DTO fields, merged official model validation with Custom blocking responses, restored official X Search while retaining Custom guards, and preserved Cyber LogOnly propagation.
- Reconciled the payment amount/pricing bridge so quick amounts, discount/bonus display, channel limits, fees, and submitted input amounts use one pricing source.

## Database

- Official migrations are present: `backend/migrations/241_add_payment_order_bonus_amount.sql` and `backend/migrations/241_add_typesafe_platform.sql`.
- Structural changes: `payment_orders.bonus_amount`; `user_platform_quotas_platform_check`; `composite_model_routes_target_platform_check`.
- Generated Ent schema/entity code was regenerated with `go generate ./ent` and `go generate ./cmd/server`; no production DDL or DML was executed.
- Before deployment, run read-only checks against `information_schema.columns`, `pg_constraint`, and `schema_migrations` for the two migration files and the three affected structures.
- Migration 241 is forward-only. Back up PostgreSQL and verify the migration runner checksum before applying; binary rollback alone does not roll back these schema changes.

## Validation

- Passed targeted Go tests for `./internal/handler`, `./internal/service`, and `./internal/custom/...`.
- Passed frontend targeted Vitest (58/58), lint, typecheck, and production build.
- Full Go tests retain only three Windows `PgDumper` process/lock tests; these require Linux CI confirmation and are recorded as inherited platform validation.
- Full frontend Vitest retains five assertions in two existing settings/subscription suites that expect the pre-TypeSafe platform count or omit an existing Custom field; they were not changed to mask the upgrade behavior.
- No production server, database, secret, or live business acceptance operation was executed in this upgrade workspace.

## Release and rollback

- Candidate baseline is bound to `vendor-0.2.13` / `3040209f205472038c1ba745a1bedd2edd9053b1`; the immutable Vendor tag is created only by the trusted upgrade finalizer after the exact PR is merged.
- Custom Release publication must target the exact merged `main` SHA and separately verify CI, boundaries, checksums, manifest, and OCI digests.
- Production installation, restart, migration completion, health checks, runtime SHA, and business traffic acceptance remain separate post-release actions.
